name: Assess ledgerly-api dependencies and plan upgrades

brief.objective: Clear known vulnerabilities in ledgerly-api and plan a move to Python 3.12.

intake.targets: Fix known vulnerabilities; run on Python 3.12
intake.upgrade_policy: Majors need approval; no new dependencies without approval; 7-day release age

notes: Expect 4 findings (quillhttp HIGH minor fix, tabulon MEDIUM major-only fix, yamlette CRITICAL no fix, left-trim-lite MEDIUM minor fix). A good plan ranks yamlette as an exception with a mitigation, asks before the tabulon major, and drafts migration rules for collections ABC aliases, datetime.utcnow and quillhttp.get_legacy.
